title: Install a separate Phase 0 operating substrate on DALEOBANKS main lineage
problem: DALEOBANKS has useful persona, evidence, safety, IdeaRefinery, platform, and opportunity-routing mechanisms, while the founder-intent PR is documentation-only and the executable publication PR is a separate shadow lineage. The repository lacks one canonical account authority record and one attributable source-to-localization-to-shadow-receipt transaction. The decision must add that smallest loop without rewriting the runtime, stacking unrelated branches, claiming live authority, or treating simulation as reality.
baseline: main at 1ba3b85474af60c1c0b1f34159f464cf69011e18 contains a production-shaped X agent, hash-chained ledger, kill switch, capability grants, AccountLane, IdeaRefinery, source citation library, platform multiplexer, and WMI mock/http client; it does not contain the PR #65 founder-intent documents or PR #66 Aperture shadow implementation, and it has no canonical Account Registry lifecycle or source-to-shadow publication receipt object.

alternatives.name: Documentation-only continuation
alternatives.description: Add or expand architecture documents while leaving executable gaps unchanged.
disadvantages: Repeats the failure mode the founder explicitly rejected
Produces no executable evidence or closed transaction
alternatives.revival_evidence: Revive only if repository mutation is no longer authorized and the requested output becomes an architecture review rather than an implementation.

alternatives.name: Stack implementation on PR #66
alternatives.description: Extend the existing Aperture shadow-publication branch with all Phase 0 media controls.
advantages: Reuses an existing shadow publication path
disadvantages: Couples this work to a separate Claude lineage and vendored artifact dependency
Obscures whether failures come from Aperture or DALEOBANKS controls
alternatives.revival_evidence: Revive after PR #66 is merged or its API becomes the explicitly selected canonical publication authority.

alternatives.name: Build all requested phases immediately
alternatives.description: Implement media, owned audience, community, commerce, WMI, PumpStation, aspiration, and civilization-seeding systems in one branch.
advantages: Avoids a later migration if every design guess is correct
disadvantages: Violates the stage-gate and anti-cathedral rules
Creates large unverified authority, privacy, commercial, and maintenance surface
alternatives.revival_evidence: Revive only after each prior phase has real external evidence, stable ownership, and a measured bottleneck requiring the next capability.

alternatives.name: Separate Phase 0 vertical slice
alternatives.description: Branch from main, reuse existing mechanisms, add canonical account/source/content/receipt records, close one shadow-only transaction, label simulations, and leave all external effects disabled.
advantages: Keeps PR #65 and PR #66 lineage intact
Builds reusable substrate for later phases
disadvantages: Adds models and API surface before real audience evidence exists
Still cannot prove market, user, or WMI outcomes
alternatives.revival_evidence: This is the selected reversible experiment; retain only while it reduces integration uncertainty and does not create a local optimum.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: DALEOBANKS remains an X-oriented agent with strong local safety mechanisms but without a canonical multi-surface account registry, structured content provenance, localization parity contract, or permanent mock provenance.
disadvantages: Founder intent remains documentation without runtime substrate
Mock WMI results remain easy to misread
Future platform growth repeats account and evidence ambiguity

roles.position: Build upward from the historical runtime while preserving the global institution and staged destination.
material_concerns: PR #65 must remain visible and unmodified
A narrow implementation must not shrink the founder's long-range intent

roles.position: Use existing AccountLane, ledger, BaseSocialClient, IdeaRefinery, and durable store as seams; add one bounded service instead of a second system.
material_concerns: Avoid duplicate approval and publish paths
Keep wire ownership and persistence backward compatible

roles.position: Assume the new abstraction will accidentally arm a shadow adapter, leak credentials, create fake account identity, or promote simulation to evidence.
material_concerns: Adapter-local live state was not enforced by the base gate
Account metadata could become implicit authority

roles.position: Prefer one service, additive dataclass fields, normal FastAPI endpoints, and explicit work-packet continuation over a framework rewrite.
material_concerns: New governance records must not become a second planning bureaucracy
The full suite must remain fast and offline-capable

roles.position: Only claim implementation and shadow evidence; require sources, counterarguments, uncertainty, humane framing, finance disclosure, and zero external effects.
material_concerns: Shadow output is not audience impact
Public-discussion sources cannot support high-risk claims
Immigrant and financial topics create heightened dignity and advice risks

evidence.claim: The clean main baseline is the expected commit.
evidence.reference: git rev-parse HEAD and git rev-parse origin/main
evidence.finding: Both resolved to 1ba3b85474af60c1c0b1f34159f464cf69011e18 before the branch was created.

evidence.claim: The existing runtime already contains reusable safety and domain mechanisms.
evidence.finding: The repository has a hash-chain, kill switch, exact grants, a common publish gate, the real IdeaRefinery domain path, and WMI wire serialization.

evidence.claim: The selected vertical slice is executable in shadow mode.
evidence.finding: Source, claim, content, localization, experiment, account authority, adapter shadowing, and receipt persistence are covered with negative controls.

evidence.claim: The integrated repository remains green after the change.

counterevidence.claim: A working shadow loop proves media, community, or commercial success.
counterevidence.finding: No official account, live publication, owned-audience conversion, paying customer, advancement action, or real WMI execution exists.

counterevidence.claim: All long-range implementation deliverables belong in this atomic change.
counterevidence.reference: DALEOBANKS Complete Master Implementation Prompt section 71
counterevidence.finding: The founder's own phased construction sequence requires evidence-gated expansion rather than simultaneous completion.

pass_1.intended_outcome: Create the smallest reusable DALEOBANKS transaction that turns declared source evidence into an authority-evaluated multilingual shadow receipt while preserving founder intent, historical mechanisms, and zero-live-effect posture.

advantages.statement: A canonical Account Registry replaces inferred identity and implicit lane activity.
advantages.amplified_value: Make account lifecycle, owner, authorization, limits, disclosures, and compromise state reusable across every future platform.

advantages.statement: One source and content knowledge graph feeds many local expressions without changing material facts.
advantages.amplified_value: Make every researched thesis a compounding multilingual portfolio asset instead of one disposable post.

advantages.statement: Shadow receipts and mock provenance prevent simulated activity from becoming institutional fact.
advantages.amplified_value: Give later analytics, commercial, and WMI consumers a trustworthy evidence boundary.

disadvantages.statement: New records and endpoints add complexity before a real external outcome exists.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Limit Phase 0 to one vertical slice, one active SBM, shadow-only execution, and a kill criterion if it does not reduce time to the first authorized external test.

disadvantages.statement: Account Registry metadata could be mistaken for live authority.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Make the registry explicitly prerequisite-only, require declared authorization references for ACTIVE state, and retain exact capability consumption at the consequence gate.

disadvantages.statement: Structural claim parity cannot prove a translation is semantically accurate.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Treat the material-facts hash as necessary but insufficient; require specialist or human localization review before an authorized production artifact.

disadvantages.statement: A larger app.py increases maintenance cost and import-time coupling.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Keep business logic in services/media_operating_system.py and services/account_registry.py; expose thin endpoints now and set route extraction as a review trigger if the surface grows.

comparisons.baseline: Baseline preserves useful safety but leaves identity, provenance, localization, and mock truth gaps open.
comparisons.do_nothing: Doing nothing has low regression risk and guarantees no progress against the explicit implementation request.
comparisons.simplest_viable_alternative: Mock labeling plus the adapter-local shadow gate alone would fix two hazards but would not create the governing media transaction.
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: Stacking on PR #66 offers a stronger publication authority abstraction but adds a cross-lineage artifact dependency before its canonical ownership is decided.
comparisons.reversible_experiment: Additive dataclasses and services on a dedicated branch, retain historical fields and APIs, execute shadow-only tests, and open a draft PR without merge or deployment.

rejected_alternatives.name: Documentation-only continuation
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: It produces no runtime evidence and repeats a directly rejected outcome.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: The founder changes the task from implementation to architecture review.

rejected_alternatives.name: Build all phases immediately
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: It maximizes unverified complexity and violates the phase sequence.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: Every preceding phase has reconciled real outcomes and the remaining capability is the measured bottleneck.

rejected_alternatives.name: Stack on PR #66
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Its branch lineage and artifact dependency are unresolved relative to this main-based implementation.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: PR #66 is merged or explicitly declared the canonical publication owner.

pass_2.attack_summary: Attack the strengthened design as a bureaucratic internal cathedral: it may create elegant registries and receipts that no audience wants, centralize too much media state in one service, overfit to X-shaped posting, or game success by counting dry-run completion. Also assume a stale live flag, credential leak, or mock result will bypass labels.

new_weaknesses.statement: The active SBM could be gamed by producing more shadow receipts instead of a real outcome.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Use a binary controlled-loop closure target of 1/1 only for Phase 0, then retire it; shadow counts remain analytics-not-applicable and cannot become advancement or commercial metrics.

new_weaknesses.statement: MediaOperatingSystem may become a new monolith that owns generation, authority, evidence, publication, and analytics.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Keep it an orchestrator: IdeaRefinery owns draft generation, AccountRegistry owns account prerequisites, BaseSocialClient owns adapter gating, capability service owns exact authority, and existing ledgers own events.

new_weaknesses.statement: The first adapter and artifact format remain post-oriented and could hard-code X assumptions.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Require platform on registry and localization records, use BaseSocialClient interfaces, and keep the content ontology multi-format while activating only a registered adapter.

new_weaknesses.statement: The real WMI and Golden Kernel boundaries cannot be verified from this repository alone.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Label HTTP, inbound-unverified, and mock execution separately; preserve the open boundary in the work packet and make cross-repo proof a later explicit scope decision.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Accept the smallest additive complexity only while it closes the controlled loop and accelerates the first real evidence test.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Before any Phase 2 owned-distribution implementation or if route/model count expands without external evidence.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Registry external approval is explicitly prerequisite-only and exact capability grants remain mandatory for consequence execution.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Any ACTIVE account transition or live publication implementation.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Structural parity is a necessary automated guard but semantic localization quality remains a human or specialist review responsibility.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Before the first production artifact in each language and market.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Thin endpoints are acceptable for the atomic phase; modular route extraction is deferred until the route group changes again.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: The Phase 0 media route group gains another material responsibility or app.py exceeds maintainable review scope.

pass_2.final_design: Create a dedicated main-based draft PR containing additive persistent records, a canonical AccountRegistry service, a bounded MediaOperatingSystem orchestrator, adapter-local shadow enforcement in BaseSocialClient, permanent WMI execution provenance, thin API routes, exact negative controls, machine-readable founder intent, two-pass deliberation, ownership, inventory, and a single continuation packet. No account is pre-populated, no credentials are stored, no live flag is enabled, no external action is taken, and no other repository is changed.

residual_risks.risk: The implementation may become an internal local optimum without a real user, buyer, or owned-audience test.
residual_risks.mitigation: Retire the Phase 0 SBM after 1/1 closure and require the next smallest implementation to be an explicitly authorized external evidence pilot.
residual_risks.owner: Alfonso Lopez and DALEOBANKS business operator

residual_risks.risk: Localization text can retain claim identifiers while changing meaning.
residual_risks.mitigation: Require qualified bilingual review and later semantic parity evaluation before production authority.

residual_risks.risk: PR #66 may become canonical and create overlapping publication receipt concepts.
residual_risks.mitigation: Do not stack or copy PR #66; compare contracts and converge ownership after its disposition is known.
residual_risks.review_trigger: PR #66 merges, closes, or receives an explicit canonicality decision.

dissent.handling: Preserve the anti-cathedral dissent as a binding stage gate rather than suppressing it; the implementation is retained only as a reversible substrate experiment.

entries.position: A code-complete shadow loop is not valuable until an authorized real participant or buyer produces an outcome.
entries.rationale: Internal correctness cannot establish usefulness, trust, advancement, or commercial demand.
entries.evidence_threshold: One authorized pilot with a predeclared outcome, zero unauthorized effects, and a preserved negative or positive result.
entries.review_trigger: Immediately after Phase 0 validation and before additional internal expansion.

migration_plan: Add fields backward-compatibly to existing dataclasses, preserve AccountLane.active as a historical compatibility field while status becomes canonical, route new API operations through services, keep all accounts unregistered by default, and defer any production adapter, credential, scheduler, or cross-repository integration to a separately authorized phase.

steps: Freeze or close the dedicated draft PR without merging.
Remove the additive endpoints, services, models, and governance files from the branch.
Restore BaseSocialClient and WMI assessment fields to the unchanged main behavior if independent fixes are not retained.
Re-run the full Python suite against origin/main and preserve this deliberation as rejected evidence.

kill_criteria: Any Phase 0 test or runtime path produces an unauthorized external effect.
A mock or inbound-unverified assessment can be represented as actual WMI execution.
Account registration can store credential material, infer an official handle, or self-promote authority.
The full Python suite regresses relative to the clean main baseline.
The substrate adds ongoing planning or maintenance cost without reducing time to the first authorized external evidence test.
review_trigger: The dedicated draft PR has validated code and CI evidence, or any kill criterion is met.
